fact: mTOMADY, a health-financing platform, announced it is now interoperable with DHIS2, the national health data system of the Ministry of Public Health, with DEPSI thanked for collaboration; no data flows, routine use or scope are stated.

DHIS2 reports that the Government of Madagascar and HISP UiO launched a World Bank-funded collaboration under the PPSB project to build a DHIS2-based One Health platform and an interoperable laboratory information system, to integrate data flows between ministries.
